jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Project Manager (f/m/d) Offshore Automation, you will lead complex international automation projects from the tender phase through engineering, execution, testing, commissioning, and final customer handover. You will be responsible for project delivery, including schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholder management, while driving standardization, operational excellence, and project profitability. In addition, you will leverage your automation expertise and project management experience to introduce digital tools, AI-supported ways of working, and modern collaboration methods that enhance project performance and execution quality.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* End-to-end responsibility for Offshore Automation sub-projects, including project execution, cost, schedule, quality, risk, and customer satisfaction
* Coordination and stakeholder management across customers, engineering, commissioning, suppliers, consortium partners, and international project teams
* Management of contractual, technical, commercial, and project-specific requirements to ensure alignment, compliance, and successful delivery
* Proactive governance of project risks, opportunities, claims, changes, and deviations throughout the entire project lifecycle
* Implementation of standardized and modular automation solutions to enhance quality, efficiency, scalability, and project profitability
* Continuous improvement of project execution through digital tools, data-driven transparency, AI-supported methods, and standardized processes, governance, and collaboration models

What You Bring

* Technical degree or professional qualification in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; alternatively, substantial project management experience gained through vocational career paths
* Project Management Certification (e.g., PM@Siemens or IPMA) combined with extensive experience in managing complex technical projects in automation, energy, infrastructure, offshore, or comparable industries
* Expertise in international project management with multiple stakeholders, demanding customers, and complex execution interfaces
* Strong knowledge of automation and control systems, software-based solutions, engineering processes, testing, and commissioning activities
* Commercial and project governance competence, including budget management, cost forecasting, profitability control, as well as risk, claim, change, schedule, and resource management
* High international mobility, excellent English communication skills, and a collaborative, forward-thinking mindset with a strong interest in digitalization, AI, automation trends, and intercultural teamwork

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role:

As the ERP Design & Build Lead for our Life Science business, you will lead the design, governance, and continuous evolution of the global SAP S/4HANA process and system template as part of our global ERP transformation program. Working closely with Business Process and IT Solution Owners, Deployment Leads, and key members of our external implementation partners, you will drive the translation of business requirements into scalable, standardized, and compliant ERP solutions while maintaining the integrity of the global template across multiple deployments. You will provide leadership throughout the design and build lifecycle—from requirements and solution design through build completion, deployment readiness, and cutover support. Your leadership will ensure a high-quality, implementation-ready solution that enables successful global rollouts while preserving standardization and a clean-core architecture

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end ERP Design & Build function within the global SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
- Own the governance, quality, and continuous evolution of the global ERP process and system template.
- Drive solution design activities, ensuring business requirements are translated into scalable, standardized, and compliant SAP solutions.
- Govern design decisions and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture principles, clean-core strategy, validation requirements, and global standards.
- Provide leadership and governance for the execution of design and build activities across functional workstreams and implementation partners, ensuring completeness, quality, and readiness for deployment.
- Ensure design consistency and template integrity across multiple concurrent deployment programs while balancing global standardization with justified local requirements.
- Partner closely with Deployment Leads to enable template confirmation, solution adoption, deployment readiness, cutover planning, and issue resolution.
- Provide governance across Application Integration, Data Migration, Testing, Validation, Security, and Platform teams to ensure an integrated, deployment-ready solution.
- Ensure ERP solutions are designed, built, and delivered in compliance with validation requirements and quality standards, partnering closely with Validation organizations to support deployment into regulated environments.
- Drive planning and governance for design, build, testing readiness, defect resolution, and cutover preparation across all functional domains.
- Identify technical and functional risks early and proactively manage dependencies that could impact deployment timelines or solution quality.
- Provide leadership and direction to internal teams, external implementation partners, and SAP, while driving accountability, delivery excellence, and effective collaboration.
- Leverage SAP S/4HANA innovations and emerging technologies to continuously improve the global ERP template and accelerate future deployments.

Who You Are:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- 10+ years of experience leading SAP S/4HANA design, build, and large-scale transformation programs, including significant experience with SAP S/4HANA.
- Extensive experience designing and governing global ERP templates within multinational organizations.
- Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture and business processes across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, and Quality Management.
- Proven leadership experience managing global design and build teams across multiple functional workstreams and implementation partners.
- Strong knowledge of solution template governance, enterprise architecture, clean-core principles, and SAP implementation methodologies.
- Demonstrated experience leading ERP solution delivery in GxP-regulated Life Science, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or similarly regulated industries is highly desirable.
- Deep understanding of deployment readiness, testing, cutover governance, and transition from build to deployment.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior business and IT leaders across global organizations.
- Outstanding communication and presentation skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into business value.
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to balance standardization, business value, risk, and delivery timelines.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority in a matrix organization.
- Experience leading multiple concurrent initiatives within a global transformation program.
- Fluent in English (mandatory). German or another European language is considered an advantage.

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in Germany.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

IT Coordinator Europe, Wilhelmsen Ships Service GmbH

Do you want to work for the most ambitious company in the international maritime industry challenging the status quo and help to drive the maritime industry and beyond?

Founded in Norway in 1861, Wilhelmsen is now a comprehensive global maritime group providing over half of the merchant fleet with essential products and services, along with supplying crew and technical management to the largest and most complex vessels ever to sail. Committed to shaping the maritime industry, we also seek to explore and develop new opportunities within the renewables, offshore and energy industries. Supporting a diverse and inclusive workplace, with thousands of colleagues in more than 70 countries, we take competence, sustainability, innovation, and unparalleled customer experiences one step further.

The position:

We are looking for an IT Coordinator who will be joining our Global Business Services division.

Global Business Services provides high quality, scalable and cost-efficient business support services, such as finance, HR and IT, to companies in the Wilhelmsen group.

What you will be doing:

We believe in proactive IT Support and want to empower our users with good knowledge of the tools they need to use to perform their job. In addition to the Microsoft 365 applications, we utilize the functionalities in ServiceNow to automate as much as possible, leaving our team to focus on user interaction, along with technical issues that may require physical attention.

We also have high focus on providing great service, so monitoring user satisfaction and identifying improvement potential is an integral part of this role. We have a 1st Line support team, that also needs guidance on how to support our users in the best way.

Next to 2nd line IT tasks this role will also coordinate local activities and projects related to implementation of new business applications, infrastructure changes as well as management of local IT vendors.

About the department:

The IT Coordinators are part of the User Experience team. Divided in an IT Coordinators West and East Team, providing our 2nd line and proactive services towards our internal and external customers.

In this role you become member of our User Experience West team, which is part of a global team, having colleagues not just in Europe but all over the world!

Who you are:

Are you highly motivated by helping people improve their IT knowledge on the latest Microsoft 365 tools?

Would you like to work in an international environment, where English is the corporate language, utilizing the very latest Modern Workplace technology and applications?

If so, you could be part of our team!

Classified as Internal - This content is proprietary information intended for employees and partners only.

Required experience and skills:

•Excellent written and spoken English and German skills as well as the ability to understand & convey complex IT Scenarios

•A service minded attitude and the ability to communicate with all levels within the business

•A high-level degree in IT or Business Administration or relevant industry experience.

•A driver license

What we offer:

•A fulltime (38,5 hours) as well as permanent contract

•Flexibility in working location

•An attractive salary package

•A laptop and mobile phone

•We offer bike-leasing

•You enjoy 30 annual vacation days

•An open, Scandinavian-influenced culture

Applying:

If you think you have what it takes to excel in this role, please apply online through our career portal by creating a ‘Candidate Home’ account. Here you can upload your resume in English, your salary expectations and your motivational letter including your earliest start date.

www.wilhelmsen.com/careers/

Work location: Hamburg City

Contact details: Maraike Oelkers, HR Manager Germany

Company Description

Arvato is an innovative and globally leading 3PL service provider in Supply Chain Management and E-commerce. With around 20,000 team members across more than 100 locations, we focus on the industries Consumer Products, Tech, Healthcare, Automotive, and Publishing.

You will work in an environment built on collaboration, respect, commitment, and curiosity, where you can grow, contribute your ideas, and make a real impact. Become part of the team that delivers logistics excellence and shapes global supply chains. Because working at Arvato means: Together, we're on it.

Job Description

Are you passionate about driving inventory accuracy, optimizing processes, and creating transparency in a dynamic logistics environment? At our site in Egelsbach, you will take ownership of inventory management across a multi-client operation, working closely with clients, warehouse teams, and management to deliver operational excellence. We believe in growing together, taking responsibility, continuously improving the status quo, and delivering results that make a difference. Are you on it?

Your Responsibilities

- Inventory Accuracy & Stock Control: Ensure daily alignment between physical inventory and SAP records while driving initiatives to improve stock accuracy, minimize losses, and establish sustainable inventory control standards.
- Inventory Reconciliation & Root Cause Analysis: Conduct regular inventory reconciliations with clients, identify discrepancies, analyze root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions to ensure long-term inventory integrity.
- Cycle Counting & Physical Inventory Management: Design and execute cycle count programs and lead annual wall-to-wall inventory counts in compliance with contractual requirements, company policies, and operational standards.
- Process Optimization & SAP Excellence: Develop and implement best-practice inventory procedures, collaborate closely with warehouse operations and SAP teams, and continuously improve inventory booking processes, stock flow, and space utilization.
- Reporting & Stakeholder Management: Provide management and clients with meaningful inventory reports and actionable insights while fostering strong collaboration across all organizational levels, from warehouse employees to senior leadership.

Qualifications

- Professional Experience: You have proven experience in inventory management, ideally within a 3PL and multi-client logistics environment, and a strong understanding of inventory control and reconciliation processes.
- SAP & Analytical Skills: You possess extensive SAP knowledge in inventory management, reporting, and reconciliation and are highly skilled in analyzing inventory variances and deriving effective solutions.
- Process Improvement Mindset: You enjoy challenging existing processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and implementing sustainable solutions that enhance operational performance.
- IT & System Competence: You have advanced Excel skills and experience collaborating with SAP IT teams to optimize system processes and inventory booking procedures. A valid license for operating industrial trucks is considered an advantage.
- Language & Communication Skills: You have very good English Skills (Germans Skills are a strong Plus) and communicate confidently with clients, management, and operational teams. A proactive, responsible, solution-oriented, and collaborative mindset completes your profile.

Additional Information

- ArvatoCare – Company Health Insurance: Your health matters to us. Benefit from a complimentary supplementary health insurance plan including an annual health budget and no health check requirement.
- Responsibility from Day One: Take ownership of a critical operational function and actively shape inventory excellence within a growing logistics environment.
- Development Opportunities: Expand your professional and personal capabilities through challenging projects, continuous learning, and close collaboration with experienced colleagues and leaders.
- Corporate Benefits: Access attractive discounts and special offers across numerous well-known brands and services.
- Open and Collaborative Culture: Experience a strong team spirit, short decision-making paths, and a work environment where ideas, ownership, and continuous improvement are valued.

Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology. Starting date: as soon as possible, at the latest September 1,2026.

Area of responsibility

The Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology aims to recruit a highly motivated post-doctoral scientistto join the Cell Biology group, headed by Prof. Dr. Sjoerd van Wijk. We study how ubiquitination andautophagy control cell survival, programmed cell death, inflammation and cell differentiation inbroad pathophysiological settings, including oncology and infection. For this, human and animalpre-clinical experimental systems, including cell lines, primary cells, organoids and iPSC-derivedcells, will be integrated with cell biology with biochemistry, molecular biology and omicsapproaches, including CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing, super-resolution and confocal microscopy andmass-spectrometry. For examples of recent research, see Wächtershäuser et al, Signal TransductTarget Ther, 11(1):204; Zein et al, Autophagy, 21(5):1075-1095 and Weinelt et al, Cell Death Dis,15(1):77.

The position will be closely involved in shaping the research group, setting up the lab and planningand performing independent research at the interface of cell biology, biochemistry and molecularbiology with imaging and computational data analysis. The successful candidate will play centralroles in collaborations between different scientific and clinical research groups and in developinginnovative approaches in comparative cell biology to improve animal and human health. Theposition furthermore combines opportunities for teaching, scientific and academic qualification(Habilitation) and the development of independent research projects within the scope of the group.

Key Focus Areas:

• Independent experimental scientific research in comparative cell biology.

• Teaching and supervision of Bachelor, Master and PhD students/Habilitation.

• Coordination of lab setup and daily running.

• Contribution to the development and implementation of integrative analytical approaches forcell biology, biochemistry and molecular biology, incl. multi-omics, CRISPR/Cas-basedapproaches, imaging and bioinformatic image analysis.

• Support in the analysis of large datasets (e.g., RNA-seq, single-cell data and imaging).

• Support in the preparation of scientific publications and grant applications, for example for theGerman Research Foundation.

• Organization of scientific exchange activities, workshops and project meetings.

Recruitment requirements:

• A university degree and doctoral degree/PhD in (Molecular) Cell Biology, Biochemistry, MolecularBiology, Biology, Veterinary Medicine ("Approbation"), or a related discipline.

• Excellent written and spoken German and English language skills.

• Experience with, or strong interest in, multiscale imaging, CRISPR/Cas-based methods andprimary cell/tissue culture (organoids).

• Basic knowledge in the analysis of high-dimensional biological datasets, particularly microscopicdatasets.

• Knowledge of additional disciplines, including systems biology, gene regulation, epigenomics ormultiscale data integration, is advantageous.

Required professional knowledge and personal skills:

• Ability to communicate complex scientific concepts across disciplinary boundaries.

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working style.

• Excellent organizational, communication and teamwork skills.

• Willingness to contribute to scientific coordination, develop independent research questions andparticipate in the preparation of publications and grant applications.

• Curious, strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills combined with the ability to developinnovative solutions.

• Flexibility and willingness to rapidly familiarize oneself with new technologies and researchareas.

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airframe Engineering, Airbus Operations is looking for a

F&DT Lead Engineer for Fuselage Primary Structure (d/f/m)

Become part of a pioneering team with a strong identity and a shared commitment to delivering best-in-class stress solutions!

Join the Fuselage Structure Analysis team in Hamburg as a technical anchor in our newly integrated "One Fuselage" domain. As the Lead Engineer Fatigue & Damage Tolerance (F&DT) for Primary Structure, you will be a custodian of structural integrity, driving the F&DT justification for critical fuselage components across the entire aircraft lifecycle—from next-generation design and certification to manufacturing and global fleet support.

You will lead the delivery of mission-critical stress engineering data and shape the departmental strategy for innovation. This is a pivotal role where you will collaborate across a high-level network to integrate advanced simulations and structural health strategies. We are looking for a pioneering engineer driven by a "People First" spirit to help us create the future of aerospace structural excellence.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location - 2 options

Hamburg is home to the largest production site for civil aircraft. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Bremen is one of the country’s greenest cities. It offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days paid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead Advanced Structural Analysis: Technically lead the project team for the fatigue and damage tolerance evaluations
- Define Airworthiness & Maintenance Criteria: Establish damage tolerance philosophies, including allowable damage limits, inspection thresholds, and repeat intervals to ensure long-term structural integrity
- Oversee Structural Testing: Plan and analyze fatigue tests across all levels, validating theoretical models with real-world data
- Drive Cross-Functional Certification: Collaborate with Design, Materials, and Stress teams to integrate F&DT requirements into the design phase, ensuring full compliance with regulatory airworthiness standards
- Support Fleet In-Service Solutions: Investigate structural failures and anomalies to determine root causes, while developing and validating effective repair schemes and service bulletins
- Manage Technical Project Deliverables: Define technical scopes, workload sizing, and lead times, ensuring high-quality inputs and the mitigation of technical risks/opportunities
- Strategic Reporting & Governance: Present progress and technical findings in steering ceremonies, providing clear clarification of assumptions and interdependencies to stakeholders
- Continuous Innovation & Method Improvement: Stay at the forefront of industry advancements to improve internal analysis tools, structural health monitoring strategies, and airworthiness limitation frameworks

In essence, you plan, structure, and deliver technical outputs for your area in Time, Cost and Quality. You guide colleagues and provide technical expertise, supported by senior team members.

Desired skills and qualifications

- You hold a Master's degree / Diploma in Engineering or similar qualifications
- You bring several years of experience in Fatigue & Damage Tolerance and associated Process, Methods & Tools
- You are experienced in technically leading employees
- You enjoy working with many interfaces with different knowledge levels and cultural backgrounds adapting your communication accordingly
- You have a creative data-driven mindset and are motivated to improve the way we work and interact with the world around us (e.g. using AI)
- You have the capabilities to interpret the environmental context and influence decision-making within the company
- Experience in Hyperworks and Python would be a plus
- Fluency in English is mandatory, German is appreciated

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
